item.title: Rangers claim Vincent Iorio off waivers from Sharks
item.description: The New York Rangers have added some depth to their blueline as the team announced they've claimed defenceman Vincent Iorio off waivers from the San Jose Sharks. Iorio was waived by the Sharks on Friday, and now finds a new home on a struggling Rangers roster. item.title: Maple Leafs Trade Rumors: Dennis Hildeby Linked to Metropolitan Club
item.description: The Toronto Maple Leafs are toast. They're going to start selling, according to at least one report. And while names like Bobby McMann, Scott Laughton and Morgan Rielly will be getting a lot of buzz, the real (only?) strength of the team at this point is goaltending. item.title: Rangers' Artemi Panarin rejected trade to Western Conference team
item.description: The New York Rangers had a deal in place to move Artemi Panarin to the Seattle Kraken, likely for a package including Shane Wright, and for now, Panarin has rejected the move. The Russian winger has a full no-movement clause and is well within his right to make things difficult for Rangers' GM Chris Drury.Panarin has been scratched for a couple of games now while Drury works on facilitating a deal he'll approve. item.description: The Calgary Flames are in sell mode at the moment and it's a tough spot to be considering ownership isn't interested in a full tear down, considering the team is opening a new arena in a couple of seasons. item.title: Edmonton Oilers waive goaltender Calvin Pickard
item.description: The Edmonton Oilers have a crowded crease, and it appears veteran goaltender Calvin Pickard has become the odd man out. The Oilers announced on Sunday, they've waived Pickard, allowing any team in the league 24 hours to claim him.Pickard, 33, is a pending unrestricted free agent, making $1 million this season against the cap. The Moncton, NB native has appeared in 16 games for the Oilers this season, posting a 5-6-2 record, along with a 3.68 goals against average, and .871 save percentage.Edmont
